what_it_really_means: Replace this array with the plain-language deep dive. Each string becomes one paragraph, so write them as paragraphs rather than bullet fragments. Start with what changes for a resident on the day the measure takes effect.
The fictional Measure ZZ would let the imaginary Example County Widget Authority levy a fee on purple widgets and spend the proceeds on widget storage. None of this exists.
Use the later paragraphs for the parts a voter would not get from the ballot title: what the text does not say, which decisions get delegated, and what happens if revenue comes in under projection.
